drive_endings.observed_source_note: PBP final_source_series_result histogram, collapsed to event family; PBP final series result; normalized to touchdown/field-goal/punt/turnover/clock/other

first_down_by_down_distance.observed_source_note: No observed down-distance first-down table; generated success is inferred from line-to-gain; joint down-distance first-down reference is not exported

pass_run_by_game_state.observed_source_note: No observed joint game-state table in the checked-in PBP export; joint down/distance/quarter/field-zone reference is not exported

pass_run_mix.observed_source_note: PBP pass/run rows; see exported play_distribution.csv; PBP play_type pass/run; denominator restricted to pass+run

pass_run_plays_per_drive.observed_source_note: PBP pass_run_rows_per_drive histogram; PBP pass/run rows per non-null drive group

plays_per_drive.observed_source_note: PBP offensive_play_rows_per_drive histogram; PBP offensive play rows per non-null drive group

possession_duration.observed_source_note: PBP snap_clock_span_seconds histogram in 30-second bins; not wall-clock possession; PBP max-minus-min snap game-clock span, grouped into 30-second bins; not wall-clock possession duration

red_zone_conversion.observed_source_note: No observed red-zone conversion cross-tab in the checked-in PBP export; red-zone conversion reference is not exported

sacks_per_dropback.observed_source_note: PBP flagged sacks per PBP flagged QB dropback; PBP source_flag:sack among source_flag:qb_dropback=1

score_margin_abs.observed_source_note: official schedule absolute-margin histogram; official retained schedule absolute score margin

third_fourth_conversion.observed_source_note: No observed third/fourth conversion cross-tab in the checked-in PBP export; third/fourth conversion reference is not exported

total_points.observed_source_note: official schedule total-points histogram; official retained schedule final scores, regular-season games

turnovers_per_scrimmage_play.observed_source_note: PBP interception plus fumble-lost flags per pass/run row; PBP interceptions + fumbles_lost over pass/run play_type rows

yards_by_down_distance.observed_source_note: No observed down-distance yards table in the checked-in PBP export; joint down-distance yards reference is not exported

yards_by_play_type.observed_source_note: PBP integer yards_gained split by pass/run; PBP yards_gained histograms conditional on play_type; keys are family|yards

coverage.conditional_reference_status: Only pass/run and yards by pass/run are exported conditionally; no observed joint down-distance, field-zone, score-state or drive-ending cross-tabs are available.
coverage.first_down_definition: Generated-only proxy: yards_gained >= yards_to_go or touchdown; LP record has no explicit first_down result field. This is inferred, not observed.
coverage.internal_stat_coherence_limits: Team totals and aggregate player-role totals are recomputed from play outcomes. possession_seconds is excluded because the E2 record lacks explicit live-play duration and stoppage semantics; no per-player identity attribution is inferred.
coverage.possession_duration_definition: Observed snap-clock span is max-minus-min retained PBP snap clock within a drive; generated counterpart is derived from drive start/end quarter and clock; both are grouped in 30-second bins. Neither measures wall-clock possession or explicit stoppage duration.
coverage.third_fourth_definition: Generated-only proxy from the same line-to-gain condition on state_before.down 3 or 4; not compared to observed reference in the available export.

scope.bootstrap_unit: generated whole games; observed aggregate histograms use a Dirichlet(counts) approximation to multinomial-resampled proportions because exported tables do not retain game keys; intervals do not preserve observed game clustering or cross-metric covariance
scope.held_out_status: NOT_HELD_OUT: current E2 baseline is sampled from the 2022-2025 PBP window, and the available observed export spans that same window

observed_reference_window.season_type: regular season, verified by exact game-key parity with nfl_schedule REG

scope.reserved_weeks_6_9: not queried as a separate split; the aggregate 2022-2025 reference includes them, and prior E3 work already examined them, so they cannot be described as blind holdout

observed_manifest.database: Legendary Picks dev SQLite database, opened with mode=ro and PRAGMA query_only=ON

definitions.drive_clock_span: max minus min game_seconds_remaining among retained rows in a drive; snap-clock span, not exact possession time
definitions.drive_terminal: series_result on the last retained play_id in each non-null (game_id, drive)
definitions.epa_success: The source success flag is EPA-positive; it is not a first-down or scoring flag.
definitions.first_down_series_terminal: series_result='First down' counted only on the last play_id within (game_id, series); result consistency is validated
definitions.game_scores: official retained nfl_schedule home_score and away_score; never reconstructed from PBP flags
definitions.histogram_nulls: Source nulls are represented as a literal NULL value in distribution tables unless the metric explicitly requires complete source coverage.
definitions.play_condition_population: play_type in pass/run/no_play, down 1-4, nonnegative ydstogo, yardline_100 0-99
definitions.player_games: role-specific non-null nfl_pbp player IDs grouped by game_id; no names or IDs exported
definitions.player_targets: receiver player-games include only pass_attempt rows with receiver_player_id; missing receiver IDs are counted in coverage
definitions.rushing_yards: yard histogram includes only player-games with non-null rushing_yards on every rush_attempt; exclusions are listed in player_stat_coverage.csv

window.season_type: regular season, verified by exact game-key parity with nfl_schedule REG

stop_rule.acceptance: After support gates, each comparable primary categorical distribution must have 95% bootstrap TVD upper bound <= 0.10; generated score variance and P90/P99 total-points tails must each be within 0.10 observed standard deviations; all required conditional cells must meet their support floor.
stop_rule.legal_gate: Every generated payload must declare valid_full_game=true; otherwise stop as not scoreable for promotion.
stop_rule.otherwise: INCONCLUSIVE; do not tune on the evaluation split. Freeze a new prospective split before any follow-up.
stop_rule.reference_support: At least 30 observed games and 30 generated games per game-level metric; at least 200 eligible observations on each side for a play/drive conditional cell.
stop_rule.rejection: Reject promotion if any comparable primary metric's 95% bootstrap lower bound exceeds its threshold in two independently seeded, frozen batches.
